metadata.description: Son of Tata and Tatië, the second Elf-father and his spouse. Born at Cuiviénen during the Years of the Trees. He is an ancestor of the Tatyarin Avari – those Noldor who did not undertake the Great Journey to Aman but remained behind with Morwë and/or Nurwë. His brother was Nurwe. Unlike Finwë (who became King of the Noldor in Aman), Maidros's line remained among the Avari or were ancestors of those who stayed in Middle-earth.
